biotools.summary: HERON is a software package for analyzing peptide binding array data. In addition to identifying significant binding probes, HERON also provides functions for finding epitopes (string of consecutive peptides within a protein). HERON also calculates significance on the probe, epitope, and protein level by employing meta p-value methods.  HERON is designed for obtaining calls on the sample level and calculates fractions of hits for different conditions.
